newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday through overnight system repurchase agreements, the Fed confirmed.
Federal funds were trading at 5-5/8 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate, at the time of the operation.
Economists had expected the Fed to add reserves to the banking system, citing seasonal pressures as well as shifts related to the April 15 personal income tax date.
-- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679
